What is the difference between ARC 244 and ARC 305?
ARC® 244 offers cost-effective standard ARC® testing for volumes up to 8.5 ml. ARC® 305 adds advanced features such as higher tracking rates (up to 50 K/min), larger vessels (up to 130 ml), stirring, injection, and enhanced venting capabilities.

Is the NETZSCH ARC system easy to operate?
Yes. ARC® systems run on the proven, intuitive NETZSCH Proteus® measurement software:
Data is automatically saved to the hard drive or server throughout the run.
The intelligent firmware monitors the status and health of key operating sensors and active components.
Safety is integrated with hardware and firmware controls.
Data files are seamlessly integrated with Proteus® analysis, NETZSCH Advanced Software Tools such as Kinetics Neo (to pedict the thermal risk in chemical processes) and third-party software.
What sample volumes are possible?
Depending on vessel type, from 1 ml to 130 ml. Vessel material and shape are chosen according to the sample’s properties.
With the ARC® 244, sample vessels up to 8.5 ml can be used. The ARC® 305 additionally allows the use of larger vessels up to 130 ml, providing greater flexibility for different applications.
How much does a NETZSCH ARC instrument cost?
The cost of a NETZSCH Accelerating Rate Calorimeters can vary depending on the model, features, and any additional accessories or software options you may require.
To get an accurate and up-to-date price for your individual NETZSCH ARC® Instrument, please contact your local NETZSCH representative or one of our authorized distributors. We will provide a quote tailored to your specific requirements, including any necessary training, installation, or additional features.

How long is the delivery time for a NETZSCH ARC?
Our current delivery time is approximately 8-12 weeks, depending on the specific configuration of the ARC® and current demand. For more complex customizations or during periods of high demand, the delivery time may extend beyond this range. 
For the most up-to-date information, we encourage you to contact us directly with a specific request. This will ensure that we can provide you with an accurate timeline tailored to your specific needs.

I am not ready to purchase an instrument at this time. Do you offer contract testing services?
Our NETZSCH applications laboratory provides contract testing services for a wide range of industries and research centers. It is equipped with state-of-the-art testing instruments allowing for a variety of measurements to be carried out. 
Consult with the NETZSCH experts in our applications labs to choose the best-suited measuring method for your specific needs. You will be working with our experienced scientists (physicists, chemists, materials scientists), possessing consolidated knowledge of the most varied methods and materials spectra.
